children: bioAffinity Technologies will present a corporate update at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference and reports ~600,736 shares outstanding with an aggregate market value of about $5.9 million as of Sept. 2, 2026.
President and CEO Maria Zannes to present and hold one-on-one investor meetings Sept. 14–16, 2026 at H.C. Wainwright conference.
Presentation will cover strategic milestones, commercial adoption and momentum for the CyPath® Lung diagnostic test.
Advancements for the company’s proprietary platform to develop additional diagnostic and therapeutic applications will be discussed.
Live and archived webcast of the presentation available Sept. 11 at https://bit.ly/BIAFPresentation for registered investors.
As of Sept. 2, 2026 there were 600,736 common shares outstanding; aggregate market value approximately $5.9 million (Nasdaq close).
